findings.message: Function call_user_method_array() is deprecated since PHP 4.1 and removed since PHP 7.0; Use call_user_func_array() instead
Function create_function() is deprecated since PHP 7.2 and removed since PHP 8.0; Use an anonymous function instead
Function create_function() is deprecated since PHP 7.2 and removed since PHP 8.0; Use an anonymous function instead
"$this" can no longer be used in a plain function or method since PHP 7.1. (existing bug, not caused by the upgrade: $this outside an object fails on every PHP version)

Since PHP 7.0, functions inspecting arguments, like func_get_args(), no longer report the original value as passed to a parameter, but will instead provide the current value. The parameter "$tag" was used, and possibly changed (by reference), on line 501. (PHP 7.0 behaviour: code that runs on PHP 7 or 8 today already gets this behaviour, so the upgrade changes nothing)
